name: motion-hold
description: Holds any Bash call, and any Monitor watch that runs a command, that would move, energise or restart lab hardware until you approve that one call (a card in a pane, or the question dialog on a narrow terminal; refused when nobody answers), and shows a STOP row while an approved call runs. Reads, logs and status pass; a stop command always passes. Generic rules are built in; the site's hosts and command patterns come from a local config file. /motion shows the state, tests a command and answers a hold.

timeoutSeconds.title: Seconds before an unanswered hold is refused
timeoutSeconds.description: How long a held command waits for Run once or Cancel before it is refused (5 to 3600; default 120).

config.title: Site config file
config.description: Absolute path of the JSON file with the site's hosts, hold and stop patterns and stop command. Empty (default): <HOME>/.claude/motion-hold.json.
